say:2:1331074001:1.text: We want to bring it back home! Even though we've had a lot of fun these past few days, it still isn't enough!
say:2:1331074001:1.source_cn: 我们想把雪带回我们的家乡！虽然玩了这几天，但是还远远不够！
say:2:1331074001:1.male: We want to bring it back home! Even though we've had a lot of fun these past few days, it still isn't enough!
say:2:1331074001:1.female: We want to bring it back home! Even though we've had a lot of fun these past few days, it still isn't enough!

say:3:1331074002:1.text: The snow will still melt in a thermos, albeit much slower. You'll be left with a flask of chilled water in the end.
say:3:1331074002:1.source_cn: 就算用保卫杯雪最终也会融化，最终只剩下一保温杯的冷水。

say:4:1331074003:1.source_cn: 不会的，雪那么冷，不会化的！
